caption: The drawing depicts a square quilt design with a cream-colored background. The quilt is composed of a grid of diamond-shaped blocks, each filled with a repeating geometric motif: a central star or floral pattern with alternating blue-green and red petals or rays, and small green leaves at the edges of each ray. The motifs are set within a faint golden or tan lattice, where interstitial spaces contain a subtle circular or sunburst pattern sketched in gold or tan lines. Surrounding the inner pattern is a wide border decorated with a repeating design of crescent shapes in red and pink, each accompanied by green and blue leaves or petals, set against the same cream-colored background as the central section. The border arrangement forms a scalloped line, with smaller red-and-green elements positioned between the crescents. The entire drawing is presented on a neutral tan-beige sheet with pencil and possibly watercolor, showing the quilt pattern in a flat, top-down view. At the top and left edges, faint pencil marks and small numbers are visible, possibly indicating measurements.
title: Patchwork Quilt
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
